intent: Define the Semantic Capsule Protocol, its meaning layer, transport layer, and cross-AI consistency rules as the authoritative foundation for all SCP-compliant capsules.

interpretation.this_is: The official SCP 0.1 specification — the semantic and transport law governing all capsules in the UBVM and Forge Theory ecosystems.
purpose: Define the meaning-bearing fields of an SCP capsule
Establish Meaning Sovereignty as a foundational principle
Specify the interpretation block and fidelity rules
Define provenance, lineage, and capsule identity
Define the transport envelope and node-to-node rules
Provide a reference capsule for authors and agents

guarantees: This document defines the canonical SCP protocol.
All SCP-compliant capsules must follow the rules defined here.
Meaning Sovereignty is a non-negotiable foundational principle.
Immutable fields must never be altered by any system or agent.
Interpretation fidelity rules override all agent inference.
Transport envelope structure is authoritative for SCP 0.1.
Cross-AI consistency rules must be enforced by all compliant agents.
non_guarantees: Implementation details of UBVM or other runtimes.
Cryptographic signing or integrity verification (deferred to SCP 0.2).
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: If contradictions arise, this specification overrides all other documents, capsules, or interpretations.

provenance.author: James / Giblets Creations
provenance.context: Created as the foundational semantic and transport protocol for UBVM and Forge Theory. Revised to move semantic_contract into interpretation, correct capture_mode, and add daily validation behaviour.
